verdict.rationale: Stripe documents access to an account's current and available balances, pairs balance data with ACH Direct Debit collection, frames balances as a way to reduce underwriting risk, and emits a webhook when a balance refresh completes, which suggests asynchronous refreshes. However, nothing in the pack shows a synchronous, real-time pre-payment balance call or explicit NSF-check guidance. A community report also cites a daily-pull limit, which weakens the 'real-time' part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of an on-demand real-time balance refresh, documentation of balance checks specifically for NSF before initiating a payment, and independent hands-on confirmation of balance freshness.
